top_band: snow-covered pitched roof slope with horizontal snow ridges (white/light blue-grey), rows 8-51 (44 rows)
evidence: Rows 8-51 show the wide foreshortened south roof slope covered in snow ridges (44 rows). Row 48 has a bright front snow lip/edge, rows 49-51 form the overhanging snow eave, and rows 52-55 show dark eave shadows and hanging icicles over the recessed wooden front wall and double doors (rows 52-75, 24 rows).

style.evidence: The snow roof uses 5-6 distinct value steps (pure white, pale blue, mid blue-grey, dark blue-grey, plus mossy thatch patches) with textured snow drift ridges. The wooden wall and doors use 5 brown tones with vertical plank grain, recessed framing, iron bands, shields, and icicles. Outlines are dark brown/dark slate material tones rather than flat black.
